runtimeNotes.maplibre-web: Passed in headless Chrome after two example fixes: Vite inlined a second React into react-map-gl, then the MapLibre worker failed inside the prebundle. resolve.dedupe and optimizeDeps.exclude maplibre-gl. The line was visible. Fly north ended at longitude -122.32, latitude 47.64, origin unknown. Remount removed the previous canvas and restored the initial framing.
runtimeNotes.maplibre-ios: Passed on iPhone 18 Pro, iOS 27. The line was visible. Fly north ended at longitude -122.32, latitude 47.64, origin unknown. Remount restored the initial framing. Presses invoked the example button handlers through the app debug connection; this host has no Simulator tap command. Earlier build failures: the MapLibre SPM post_install was missing, and iOS 27 rejected the template UIWindow launch until a scene delegate was added.
runtimeNotes.maplibre-android: Passed on the Medium_Phone emulator, API 37. The line was visible. Fly north logcat ended at longitude -122.32, latitude 47.64, origin unknown. Remount logcat returned to longitude -122.34, latitude 47.61 and the initial framing. The app uid cannot open 10.0.2.2:8081, so the debug host was set to the computer LAN address. The nearby-devices prompt was dismissed.
runtimeNotes.mapbox-web: Passed after the public token moved to the shell variable. An earlier run was blocked because examples/web-mapbox/mapbox-access-token.js was empty. A later attempt failed WebGL when Chrome was started with --disable-gpu, then failed because Vite prebundled a second mapbox-gl module whose access token stayed empty. With one mapbox-gl module, the line was visible. Fly north ended at longitude -122.32, latitude 47.639999999999986, zoom 11, bearing 0, pitch 0, origin unknown. Remount replaced the canvas and restored the initial framing.
runtimeNotes.mapbox-ios: Passed on iPhone 18 Pro, iOS 27. An earlier run was not built because the token file was empty. The line was visible. Fly north ended at longitude -122.32, latitude 47.64, zoom 11, pitch 0, origin unknown. Remount logged longitude -122.34, latitude 47.61, zoom 11 and restored the initial framing. Presses invoked the example button handlers through the Metro debug connection. The iOS deployment target was raised to 15.0 so Xcode 27 would build MapboxMaps resources.
runtimeNotes.mapbox-android: Passed as parity with pinned @rnmapbox/maps 10.3.7 on the Medium_Phone emulator, API 37. An earlier run was not built because the token file was empty. This run used the shell token. The Maps SDK resolved after the Mapbox Maven repository was added; a download token was not required. The app uid cannot open 10.0.2.2:8081, so the debug host was written to the app preferences as the computer LAN address, and the nearby-devices prompt was dismissed. Mount and remount both logged longitude 0, latitude 0, zoom 0.6917435191712747, origin unknown, and the route was off screen. Fly north then logged longitude -122.32, latitude 47.64, zoom 11, origin unknown, and the blue line was visible. Remount created a new map rather than keeping the flown camera, and that new map again opened at 0,0. The facade passed the same Camera defaultSettings the wrapper documents. Stock RNMapbox reproduces the latitude loss on a cold style cache because a zero-duration flyTo writes center and zoom separately. The upstream fix is https://github.com/rnmapbox/maps/pull/4332 for https://github.com/rnmapbox/maps/issues/4273. Drop this peer limitation when the pinned release contains that fix.
